🟢 عکس ماشینی که می‌خوای بخری رو به همراه پرامپت زیر برای ChatGPT بفرست تا تمام خوبی‌ها، بدی‌ها و خرابی‌های رایجش رو توی یه تصویر بهت نشون بده. Act as an automotive expert, researcher, and infographic designer. Analyze my uploaded car photo, research the vehicle online, and generate ONE professional Persian infographic to help evaluate its purchase value. 1. IDENTIFICATION Identify the manufacturer, model, approximate year/generation, vehicle category, and possible trims/engines. Never guess uncertain details. Distinguish variants when necessary. 2. INTERNET RESEARCH Search Google or available web sources, prioritizing manufacturer specifications, professional reviews, reliability reports, owner experiences, safety data, and Iranian market information when relevant. Cross-check important findings and investigate: • Performance: Engine, horsepower, acceleration, transmission, fuel consumption, driving experience. • Advantages: Comfort, performance, practicality, reliability, equipment, value. • Disadvantages: Mechanical weaknesses, expensive repairs, fuel consumption, build quality, owner complaints. • Reliability: Common engine/gearbox faults, durability, maintenance requirements. • Ownership: Spare parts, repair costs, fuel expenses, resale value. • Buying checklist: Critical components and problems to inspect before purchasing. • Verdict: Everyday usability, suitable buyers, and overall purchase value. RESEARCH ACCURACY: Separate verified facts from owner opinions. Distinguish documented recurring faults from isolated complaints. Never assume the photographed vehicle has hidden defects, accident history, or altered mileage. Never invent specifications, sources, prices, statistics, or ratings. If internet access is unavailable, disclose it clearly. 3. GENERATE THE INFOGRAPHIC Create ONE high-resolution, vertical 9:16 Persian automotive infographic. Use the uploaded car as the visual reference, preserving its model, proportions, body design, and color. Feature the vehicle prominently at the top. STYLE: Premium dark automotive editorial design, elegant typography, clean information cards, realistic vehicle photography, excellent visual hierarchy, and mobile readability. LAYOUT: HEADER: "بررسی تخصصی [نام خودرو]" Verified model, generation, and production years. ① مشخصات فنی 4–6 key specifications with compact icons. ② ✅ نقاط قوت 4–6 researched advantages in green cards. ③ ❌ نقاط ضعف 4–6 researched disadvantages in red cards. ④ ⚠️ ایرادهای رایج Major documented mechanical and reliability problems in orange cards. ⑤ 🔍 قبل از خرید بررسی کن 3–5 essential inspection recommendations in blue cards. ⑥ 🚗 ارزش خرید داره؟ A prominent, balanced, evidence-based purchase verdict explaining who should or shouldn't buy it. Include the researched variant, research date, and compact source references where space allows. DESIGN RULES: All text must be accurate Persian with correct RTL layout, spelling, and readable typography. Keep information concise but meaningful. Avoid clutter, unsupported claims, unnecessary logos, and watermarks. If the exact variant cannot be identified and significantly affects the findings, ask ONE brief clarification. If live research or accurate Persian text rendering is unavailable, disclose the limitation. Use reliable text layout tools when available rather than inventing or silently omitting information.
